# SkiaSharp capability inventory — 0.67

<!-- Generated by tools/api-inventory.py --write. Edit api/*.json, not this report. -->

Baseline: `91db8bdac2431588806e128914698c354c65b260`. Comparison: SkiaSharp **3.119.1**, Skia m119 at `40f75dc0051d141913c07c20d4c19590c7da0cb7`.

## Scope and evidence

**140 capability families; 849 core C function declarations; 86 managed source files; 37 public Racket modules.**
The baseline expects **514 distinct bindings** across **nine registries**, including **463 CPU bindings**. These are not feature-completion percentages.

Each scoped C declaration has exactly one primary disposition. Managed files map to one or more capability families; this does **not** classify every C# overload, property, enum value, platform UI package, or Skia add-on. Normalized C declarations are pinned inputs; the explicit upstream-checkout gate verifies their source bytes and names.

`missing-available-abi` means a declaration exists in the pinned C interface, not that a particular native binary exports or implements it. `supported-with-limits` and `racket-equivalent` are reviewed source declarations. They do not certify every overload, backend, format, or pixel result.

Historical baseline evidence retains a Linux aggregate symbol audit, **not** a per-symbol exported list. A fresh optional child-process probe records resolution for all scoped functions with exact library hash, ABI and invocation identity. Resolution of a stub still does not prove execution. No native/rendering result is invented by generating this report.

See [API decisions](API-DESIGN-DECISIONS.md) for the additive image-info/color/lease design and [maintenance](../api/README.md) for scope, drift checks and validation commands.

## Detailed dispositions

<a id="resources-ownership"></a>
### resources.ownership — Reference counts and deterministic resource closure

**racket-equivalent**; next stage: **none scheduled**; origin: `m119`.

Native refcount inspection and arbitrary pointer ownership are not public. Safe wrappers replace raw reference manipulation.

**Document behavior:** Not a drawing operation.

**Backend declaration:** Backend-neutral wrapper/value or ownership operation; CPU/GPU lifetime distinctions remain explicit. This query does not initialize or verify a backend.

**Public source anchors:** `main.rkt:skia-close!`, `main.rkt:with-skia`.
**Implementation:** [private/core.rkt](../private/core.rkt), [private/lifetime.rkt](../private/lifetime.rkt).
**Test sources, not execution receipts:** [tests/lifetime-test.rkt](../tests/lifetime-test.rkt).

<a id="geometry-regions-extra"></a>
### geometry.regions-extra — Region spans, clipped iteration and remaining queries

**supported-with-limits**; next stage: **none scheduled**; origin: `m119`.

Half-open integer coordinates keep the existing sentinel-safe range. Native iterators are temporary; copied sequences can be traversed repeatedly instead of exposing rewind. Quick predicates are sufficient tests, not exact converses. Empty boolean result is not allocation failure.

**Document behavior:** Queries do not render. Generated ordinary paths remain vector under strict PDF/SVG audit; paint dithering requires explicit rasterization. Paint-to-path preserves geometry only, not effects that act on pixels.

**Backend declaration:** Geometry operations are CPU-side, backend-neutral authoring. Generated paths and paint are usable on existing raster/OpenGL/Metal/Direct3D canvases subject to unchanged context affinity; selected acceptance is separate from catalogue classification.

<a id="geometry-rrect-extra"></a>
### geometry.rrect-extra — Rounded-rectangle transform, inset/outset and specialized shape cases

**supported-with-limits**; next stage: **none scheduled**; origin: `m119`.

Immutable rounded-rectangle specs remain the public model. New results copy native-normalized radii. Unsupported transforms return #f; shear is not silently approximated. Pure empty construction replaces native setEmpty. Native RRect layout is never exposed.

**Document behavior:** Queries do not render. Generated ordinary paths remain vector under strict PDF/SVG audit; paint dithering requires explicit rasterization. Paint-to-path preserves geometry only, not effects that act on pixels.

**Backend declaration:** Geometry operations are CPU-side, backend-neutral authoring. Generated paths and paint are usable on existing raster/OpenGL/Metal/Direct3D canvases subject to unchanged context affinity; selected acceptance is separate from catalogue classification.

**Public source anchors:** `geometry.rkt:make-empty-rounded-rect`, `geometry.rkt:make-nine-patch-rounded-rect`, `geometry.rkt:rounded-rect-normalize`, `geometry.rkt:rounded-rect-type`, `geometry.rkt:rounded-rect-inset`, `geometry.rkt:rounded-rect-outset`, `geometry.rkt:rounded-rect-offset`, `geometry.rkt:rounded-rect-transform`.
